remarks: Discover this immaculate colonial home nestled on a peaceful double cul-de-sac in the desirable Brookside neighborhood of Norwalk. This beautifully updated residence is designed for both comfort and sophisticated entertaining, with the heart of the home being the stunning kitchen. The kitchen is truly a chef's dream, featuring new bright white cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliances. The centerpiece is the oversized 10-foot island, perfect for large family gatherings and adding a touch of luxury and functionality. Adjacent to the kitchen, the sunken family room provides a cozy space with built-ins and a warm fireplace, ideal for relaxing evenings. The layout flows seamlessly into an open-concept formal dining room and living room, perfect for hosting guests. Upstairs, find four generously sized bedrooms, including the primary suite with its own full bath. The upstairs bonus room features 12-foot ceilings and is enhanced by a custom sliding barn door leading to an enormous storage closet, providing a versatile area for various activities.  Notable features include hardwood floors throughout and a spacious backyard with an oversized composite deck leading to an above-ground pool, perfect for outdoor enjoyment. Recent updates include newer resilient vinyl siding and a freshly resurfaced driveway. This property combines elegance, functionality, and thoughtful updates, schedule your viewing, your dream home awaits.
